title: Fix keyboard navigation
when: Parts of a page cannot be used with the keyboard, tab order jumps around, or custom widgets ignore Enter, Space or arrow keys.
prompt:
Goal: Every interactive element is reachable and operable by keyboard alone in a logical order, with focus always visible.
Steps:
1. Tab through the page in order and list each stop that is missing, out of order or invisible.
2. Replace clickable div and span with button (actions) or a with href (navigation); they get focus and Enter for free.
3. Remove positive tabindex values; fix order by moving elements in the HTML, use tabindex="0" only for custom widgets and "-1" for programmatic focus.
4. For composite widgets (menus, tabs, listboxes) use roving tabindex: one stop for the group, arrow keys move inside, Home and End jump.
5. Escape closes popups and menus and returns focus to their trigger.
6. Add a strong :focus-visible outline with at least 3 to 1 contrast.
Quality bar:
- Tab order follows visual order.
- No keyboard trap anywhere.
- Shortcuts never override typing in fields.
Pitfalls:
- tabindex="5" style ordering.
- Handling only click on custom controls.
- outline: none with no replacement.
Verify:
- [ ] All actions work with Tab, Enter, Space and Escape.
- [ ] No positive tabindex remains.
- [ ] Focus is visible on every stop.
- [ ] Files parse.
Output: Updated HTML, CSS focus styles and key handlers.

examples.input: não consigo usar o menu com o teclado
examples.output: menu items are buttons, arrow keys move with roving tabindex, Escape closes and refocuses the trigger
